decision: Reviewed local candidate; hosted installation remains unverified and absent in latest QA postflight. No release approval.

independentTests.note: Expanded final run includes all14 reviewed backend cases plus MP3 truncation, idempotent upload, initial Auth A-to-B-to-A race and account change during Storage transfer.

reviewFindingsResolved: Library list metadata now requires an actual current Auth session and approved business identity; missing business guard fails closed.
PostgreSQL function-rename OID dependency fixed by recreating the story_sounds SELECT policy against a guarded public metadata helper. Owner reads are also session-bound.
Finalizer applies one45-second deadline to Auth/RPC/download/digest/finish and request/audio stream reads; uncooperative cancellation cannot block cleanup.
New music tables carry account-erasure actor fences; service finalization explicitly locks and checks the real owner erasure state.
Required media/erasure contracts and exactly one erasure allowlist anchor are checked before schema changes.
Legacy unverified story-to-sound publication shortcut is retired with actionable error.
Internal story soundtrack resolver has explicit service-only execution ACL.
Indeterminate staff-session checks fail closed with IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE.
Upload readiness defaults false; only service credentials can change it with an audit reason; license/catalogue activation stays unavailable.
coverage: Private bucket and restrictive Storage policies
Owner-bound idempotent upload reservations and content hash/version/size checks
Reuse consent separately from existing content audience playback
Warmed delivery-ticket revocation and preserved visual content authorization
Post, story and retained memory-book soundtrack authorization
Private license drafts without playback activation
False erasure acknowledgements, original object queueing, write fences and Auth cascade cleanup
limits: Container inspection verifies format/size/duration structure and hash; it does not certify music rights or guarantee every device decoder.
Local database tests use synthetic fixtures with installed privacy/erasure prerequisites. They do not imply the production dependencies are installed.
No actual uploaded audio or disposable-account Storage/CDN/Auth erasure was verified on the hosted QA environment because the migration connector did not complete.
Business Auth migration remains absent on QA; business audio safely rejects unapproved sessions.
